metadata.database: A Deeper China | Quanzhou–Dehua point decision layer

QZ001.guest_value: Begin with production, port, belief and movement as one maritime system.

QZ002.guest_value: Read Buddhist history with current worship etiquette.

QZ003.guest_value: Add Islamic maritime history only when comparison is the actual question.
QZ003.choose_rule: Follow current access and photography rules.
QZ003.stop_after: One religious plurality question is answered.

QZ004.guest_value: Connect seafaring, belief and port movement.
QZ004.choose_rule: Use one temple context, not a sacred-site circuit.

QZ005.choose_rule: Quiet, consent and site rules override photography.

QZ006.guest_value: Make gate, city edge and port movement physical.

QZ007.guest_value: Read bridge engineering and maritime movement together.
QZ007.choose_rule: Choose if infrastructure/history adds a new question.

QZ008.guest_value: Offer a public route through the port network.
QZ008.choose_rule: Use only a coherent, field-checked public path.

QZ009.guest_value: Use Nanyin as current sound and social context.
QZ009.choose_rule: Choose by programme, language, seating and consent.

QZ010.guest_value: Read Minnan food/tea through timing and shared social format.
QZ010.choose_rule: Check dietary needs and venue before any recommendation.
QZ010.stop_after: One safe food/tea format is complete.

QZ011.guest_value: Observe old-city life without treating residents as content.
QZ011.choose_rule: Public routes only; no private courtyards or staged contact.

QZ012.guest_value: Frame Dehua as production and design, not just shopping.
QZ012.choose_rule: Choose by public access and a clear production question.

QZ013.guest_value: Offer museum/showroom context without claiming maker access.
QZ013.stop_after: The public production layer is understood.

QZ014.guest_value: Show what must pass before a ceramic-maker experience is mentioned.
QZ014.choose_rule: No quote, booking or workshop promise without resource release.

QZ015.guest_value: Separate ceramic observation from authentication, price and shipping.
QZ015.stop_after: The visitor knows what remains independently verifiable.

QZ016.guest_value: Give two days a coherent Quanzhou maritime core.
QZ016.choose_rule: Use one port, one sacred/urban and one public-life question.
QZ016.stop_after: The city is legible without a temple checklist.

QZ017.guest_value: Decide whether Dehua earns a separate third day.
QZ017.choose_rule: Do not squeeze it into two days.
QZ017.stop_after: Transfer and ceramic purpose are accepted.

QZ018.guest_value: Protect payment, language, transport and foreign-visitor access.
QZ018.choose_rule: Build from actual arrival and sacred/craft schedules.
QZ018.stop_after: The visitor can navigate and enter respectfully.

QZ019.guest_value: Keep sacred and craft routes viable in rain/heat.
QZ019.choose_rule: Remove exposed or restricted layers when conditions change.
QZ019.stop_after: The fallback preserves the cultural question.

QZ020.guest_value: Pass inland/Maritime Fujian choices to a separate destination plan.
QZ020.choose_rule: No bundled route or live transport promise.
QZ020.stop_after: The visitor accepts the transfer and distinct question.
